subject.title: chore(docker): bundle channel voice plugin deps

question: Should standard source-built Docker images select Discord, Feishu, and Voice Call runtime dependencies by default instead of leaving plugin selection to `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS`?
rationale: Current main documents and implements per-image plugin selection, while this PR changes the default runtime and dependency footprint for every unset local Docker build; code review cannot determine the intended standard image policy.

options.title: Keep explicit selection
options.body: Retain the current opt-in default and document the supported plugin selections for operators who need these channel runtimes.

options.title: Adopt an approved default set
options.body: Define the supported standard-image plugin list, update all source and release build paths consistently, and add real image evidence for the resulting contract.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit selection
recommendation.body: Retain the current opt-in default and document the supported plugin selections for operators who need these channel runtimes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available current-history routing candidate for the central Dockerfile packaging path.
